mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may lower bupropion seizure threshold and increase CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, and consider seizure precautions; use bupropion cautiously or consider alternative antidepressant if amphotericin B-induced electrolyte depletion occurs.
